evidence.quote: Term sheet: class fund $38,000,000; attorneys' fees $2,500,000; clear sailing no; unawarded fees revert to defendant no; distribution automatic
The parties negotiated the class relief and attorneys’ fees in the same settlement discussions; fees were not first discussed after agreement on class relief.

summary: Plaintiff-side counsel first included attorneys’ fees in their opening term sheets, before any final agreement on class relief. Fees and class relief were discussed in the same settlement negotiations, but the transcript does not show an explicit tradeoff between fees and class recovery. The private reasoning emphasizes class recovery and fixed firm compensation, and the court declaration accurately describes the negotiation sequence.
